name: UGC Ad Video
description: Turns a product and offer into a vertical UGC performance ad: pick a format (hook, unboxing, testimonial, before/after, POV, problem-solution, GRWM, street interview, 3 reasons, A vs B), confirm inputs, generate the storyboard, then generate the shots, audio and final composite.

planning.planning_notes:
[Gates]
Gate 1: pick the UGC format; map it to its recipe (Hook → manna-ugc-hook, Unboxing → manna-ugc-unboxing, Testimonial → manna-ugc-testimonial, Before/After → manna-ugc-before-after, POV → manna-ugc-pov, Problem-Solution → manna-ugc-problem-solution, GRWM → manna-ugc-grwm, Street interview → manna-ugc-street-interview, 3 reasons → manna-ugc-three-reasons, A vs B → manna-ugc-a-vs-b).
Gate 2: confirm product, audience, offer, talent, length and aspect ratio (default 9:16, 30 s).
Gate 3: show the storyboard shot table and get approval before any generation.

[Execution path]
1. Run the chosen UGC recipe to write the storyboard.
2. If product images are provided, anchor the product with ad-product-prop-anchor.
3. Generate one clip per ai_video shot with storyboard-shot-video (max 8 s per clip, product anchor referenced); footage shots use the user's clips; graphic shots (price card, text, logo, CTA end card) are built in the composite.
4. Generate music, SFX and voiceover with video-audio-layer after all clips are done.
5. The canvas compose node assembles clips, captions and audio in storyboard order.
planning.prompt_guide: Write directions in English. Dialogue, voiceover, captions and on-screen text follow the project's film language. Keep the phone-shot UGC look: handheld, natural light, real environments, eye-level selfie framing for talking heads.
conduct_rules: Never generate clips before the storyboard is approved
Keep the confirmed aspect ratio in every image and video step
Product name, price and offer are quoted verbatim in every downstream prompt
Never name or show a real competitor brand
Each video clip binds a continuous storyboard range and is no longer than 8 seconds
Never pre-mix background music into video clips

rating_bands.description: Scroll-stopping hook, clear product, native UGC feel and a strong CTA
Solid structure with minor pacing or caption issues
Weak hook or unclear product; feels like a polished TV ad, not UGC
Off-brief, wrong format or unusable shots

visual_review_items.name: Hook strength
visual_review_items.description: The first 3 seconds stop the scroll

visual_review_items.name: Product clarity
visual_review_items.description: The product and label are clearly visible

visual_review_items.name: Caption safety
visual_review_items.description: Captions sit inside the safe area and stay readable

text_review_items.name: Beat timing
text_review_items.description: Beats match the format's second ranges

text_review_items.name: Offer accuracy
text_review_items.description: Product, price and offer are exact

text_review_items.name: CTA
text_review_items.description: A single clear call to action

domain_constraints: Every shot carries a shot type tag: ai_video, footage or graphic
Default 9:16 vertical with platform safe areas
Dialogue and captions follow the project's film language
